title: Yes. Inishturk. Inishark. Inishboffin
html_source:
Internal narrative. The reader sequences the list of islands as each island signifies meaning in the other realized as a pragmatic thought string by Bloom.

By the time Joyce writes Finnegans Wake, his relationship with signifiers changes:

anchor.prefix: . He passed Saint Joseph's National school. Brats' clamour. Windows open. Fresh air helps memory. Or a lilt. Ahbeesee defeegee kelomen opeecue rustyouvee doubleyou. Boys are they?
anchor.suffix:
. At their joggerfry. Mine. Slieve Bloom.
